audience: A distance road rider who wants the flagship bamboo build — endurance drop-bar comfort with carbon-lug joints that answer the two things road buyers worry about most: weight and stiffness — and who'd rather hand-build a one-off frame than buy another anonymous carbon machine.

positioning.title: Bamboo's ride feel, carbon-lug precision.
positioning.lede: Our premium road kit joins the bamboo with pre-formed carbon-fibre lugs instead of hand-wrapped tow — lighter, stiffer joints and a cleaner finish that looks like a custom frame-shop build. You still get bamboo's all-day vibration damping; you just get it on the lightest, stiffest, sharpest-looking frame we make.

who_for.title: You want the lightest, stiffest bamboo road frame
who_for.body: Carbon lugs are lighter and stiffer than hand-wrapped fibre joints, so this is the build for the road rider who loves bamboo's compliance but won't compromise on joint weight or power transfer. It's the answer to 'is bamboo stiff and light enough?' — yes, and more so here.

who_for.title: You want it to look like a custom frame-shop build
who_for.body: Pre-formed lugs give clean, uniform joints with none of the variability of hand-wrapping. Builders tell us people assume it came from a custom workshop, not a home kit. The premium tier looks the part.

who_for.title: You'd rather build it — with a head start
who_for.body: Lugged construction is more forgiving and noticeably faster than wrapping each joint by hand (15–25 hrs vs 20–40 on the standard kit). A flagship one-off you finished yourself — and every kit funds a place on our prison frame-building course.

faq.q: What are carbon lugs, and how are they different from the standard road kit?
faq.a: On our standard road kit you wrap each joint by hand with carbon-fibre tow and epoxy. This flagship kit instead joins the bamboo with pre-formed carbon-fibre lugs — ready-shaped carbon sockets the tubes bond into. They give a cleaner, more uniform joint, a lighter and stiffer frame, and a faster, more forgiving build. It's the same endurance road geometry and the same bamboo ride feel — just the premium construction.

faq.q: Are carbon lugs really lighter and stiffer than wrapped joints?
faq.a: Yes — that's the whole point of the lugged build. Pre-formed carbon lugs are lighter and torsionally stiffer than the equivalent hand-wrapped fibre joint, so more of your power goes to the back wheel and the finished frame is the lightest road frame we make. You still keep bamboo's natural vibration damping for all-day comfort — you're sharpening the joints, not deadening the ride.

faq.q: Is it stiff and efficient enough for fast road riding?
faq.a: Yes. Bamboo is already torsionally stiff, and the carbon lugs add stiffness at the joints, so power transfer is direct and precise. It's tuned for endurance comfort rather than crit-race harshness, but of our road builds this is the stiffest and most responsive. Tensile strength is around 28,000 PSI, comparable to mild steel.

faq.q: Why is this kit £795 when the standard road kit is less?
faq.a: The pre-formed carbon lugs are a premium component — they cost more to produce than a reel of carbon tow, and they deliver the lighter, stiffer, cleaner-finished flagship frame. You're paying for the lug construction and the result. If you'd rather hand-wrap your joints and save, the standard Road kit is the same geometry and ride feel at a lower price.

faq.q: Will the frame survive years of big road miles?
faq.a: Yes. We've seen under a 1% failure rate across 4,000+ builds since 2012, the design has been independently tested with Swansea University, and frames last 8–12 years with proper care — many of our 2012 builds are still ridden daily. Seal it, dry it after wet rides and store it indoors.
